sources.entry: Musuw - AI knowledge workspace with cited answers, connected Wiki pages, and a knowledge graph. #freemium

summary.name: musuw
summary.one_liner: musuw is an AI knowledge base that turns PDFs, documents and notes into a searchable workspace for asking cross-source questions with cited answers, connected Wiki pages, and a knowledge graph.
use_cases: Asking questions across a collection of PDFs and notes with source references
Building a connected wiki from research material that updates as new sources are added
Exploring relationships between entities, concepts and sources in a knowledge graph
Importing web articles, YouTube or TikTok/Douyin links as searchable text or subtitles
Comparing claims across documents while separating quoted evidence from model inference
summary.what_it_does: The page describes importing documents, web pages, images, tables and Markdown into one searchable knowledge base, with answers that cite the original passages. It says it can search and compare across multiple sources within a chosen scope and separates source-backed facts, model inference and information gaps. Findings can be kept as auto-generated, interlinked Wiki pages with backlinks and version traceability that update as new material is added. A knowledge graph shows typed relationships between pages, entities, concepts and sources, and lets users trace back to evidence. It also says it hosts 30+ mainstream models that can be switched within one interface.
notable: Answers include precise citations back to the original source passages
Auto-generated, interlinked Wiki pages with backlinks and version tracking
Knowledge graph with typed relationships and evidence path tracing
Hosts 30+ models switchable in one interface
caveats: Free tier is limited to 1 GiB storage, one knowledge base and 10 documents per knowledge base; higher tiers (Plus, Pro, Max) cost more and unlock more
Video import and advanced models are listed as paid-tier features beyond the free plan
Pricing amounts are not stated in the page text
